_comment: The two deployments of build phase 4.15, and the record of what was actually
provisioned. These are PUBLIC hostnames and ids, not secrets: the URLs are
printed in docs/build/Release_flow.md and handed to anyone using the demo.
No credential, token or variable VALUE ever belongs in this file.
TWO PROJECTS, not two environments, and the reason is finding F-4.15-03: a
Railway service's git source (repo plus branch) is SERVICE-level, so two
environments inside one project cannot watch two different branches. The
first attempt at this phase built two environments and had to be reversed.
The reversal is logged in DECISIONS.md on 2026-08-27.
This file is the gate's source of truth for where to probe. An entry naming
a URL nothing answers on fails P1 on reachability; a missing entry fails P1
on absence. Both halves of 'wrong' are caught rather than one.
Adding a deployment here does not create it. Creating one and forgetting
this file is what P1 exists to catch.
